description: Abstract, game-entity-independent components used to score candidate actions.

components.description: How effectively the candidate mitigates the highest-priority abstract threat.
How effectively the candidate mitigates relevant secondary threats.
How strongly the candidate advances the primary abstract team plan.
How strongly the candidate supplies a missing strategic function.
How executable the candidate is in the observed context.
How well the candidate's timing aligns with the current opportunity.
Value lost by committing to the candidate instead of alternatives.
Degree to which the candidate duplicates already-covered functions.
Coordination and execution difficulty imposed by the candidate.
Penalty for relying on evidence older than the context can tolerate.
Penalty for unresolved contradictions among relevant evidence.
